issues.title: Whole-request read-only safety still authorizes state-changing operations
issues.rootCause: Action phrase detection was allowed to survive some read-only/request-for-explanation wrappers as executable intent.
issues.repair: Request semantics now require a positively authorized executable clause for state-changing plans. Read-only wrappers, hypotheticals, quoted/reported commands, and explicit no-action scopes remain non-mutating.

issues.title: Read-only questions can still replace pending graph state
issues.rootCause: Pending replacement relied too heavily on global execute classification plus typed correction shape.
issues.repair: Pending graph replacement now requires executable semantics plus explicit pending-correction authorization. Safe impact questions and exact pending controls are routed separately.

issues.title: H2H/V2V lazy computation is effectively eager
issues.rootCause: The broad Mappings/Export sections requested both derived projections even when the user had not selected them.
issues.repair: Added selected derived-view state and request helpers so H2H/V2V are requested only for the selected mapping/export subtype.

issues.title: Projection budgets do not sufficiently bound output/main-thread work
issues.rootCause: Projection safety only bounded estimated pairs and allowed large adjacency-reference/output-row materialization.
issues.repair: Projection builders now enforce output/reference budgets before materializing oversized V2V projections.

issues.title: Dense Matrix CSV export is unbounded O(VxE)
issues.rootCause: Matrix CSV export built every dense cell and preview calls could recompute expensive text.
issues.repair: Added matrix cell/byte estimates, structured over-budget refusal, and memoized selected export text.

issues.title: JSON validation silently coerces malformed identifiers/metadata
issues.rootCause: Canonical JSON path normalized values before validating IDs, vertices, duplicates, finite weights, and time metadata.
issues.repair: JSON hyperedge input now fails closed on invalid IDs, duplicate IDs, invalid vertices, invalid time values, and non-finite weights.

issues.title: Built-in text parsers accept malformed/lossy input
issues.rootCause: Several parsers silently dropped malformed lines, accepted invalid weights, or tolerated broken CSV quoting.
issues.repair: CSV quote parsing, incidence rows, edge list arity, H2V/V2H/H2H syntax, and finite weights are validated with explicit parse errors.

issues.title: Custom Parser guard has lexical false positives
issues.rootCause: The guard searched stripped source text rather than resolving lexical scopes and free identifiers.
issues.repair: The guard now uses Acorn AST/scope analysis so local bindings, destructuring names, object keys, and regex literals are allowed while forbidden free globals/prototype escapes remain blocked.

issues.title: Bridge response caps broke token streaming
issues.rootCause: The bridge buffered the entire upstream response before writing to the client.
issues.repair: Bridge forwarding now streams upstream chunks through response-cap accounting with backpressure and abort handling.

issues.title: Upload cancellation and detection sampling incomplete
issues.rootCause: Full File.text() reads were not cancellable and the advertised detection sample limit was unused.
issues.repair: File detection reads bounded samples first; full reads use cancellable stream/FileReader paths, abort prior upload controllers, and ignore stale aborted commits.

issues.title: configure_local_model misreports successful no-ops
issues.rootCause: AgentChatPanel traced ok:true settings results as committed state mutations even when changedState:false.
issues.repair: The configure_local_model path now uses result.changedState for stateMutationCommitted.

issues.title: Real component/browser lifecycle coverage missing
issues.rootCause: Prior coverage relied heavily on source-order checks rather than rendered component submission paths.
issues.repair: Added happy-dom AgentChatPanel lifecycle tests and ran a production browser smoke covering app shell, assistant settings, runtime diagnostics, algorithms, and console errors.

issues.title: Export paths duplicate expensive projection work
issues.rootCause: Canonical/clique exporters rebuilt V2V projection and preview generated selected export text more than once.
issues.repair: Exports reuse memoized V2V result and App computes exportContent once for preview/copy/download paths.

issues.title: MODEL_SETUP active heading stale
issues.rootCause: Active setup documentation still identified an older version.
issues.repair: README, MODEL_SETUP, command docs, package metadata, and release notes now identify v7.3.13 where active-version text is expected.

issues.title: CSV serializer documentation says CRLF but implementation emits LF
issues.repair: CSV document helper now emits CRLF rows as documented, with round-trip tests updated accordingly.
